description: This Java source file defines constants and utility methods related to request-response API patterns, including methods to create AMQP messages for responses and errors, for use within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: RequestResponseApiConstants
classes.description: Contains constants and static utility methods supporting request-response messaging patterns in the API.

methods.name: getAmqpReply
methods.description: Creates an AMQP message in response to a service invocation, setting correlation ID, address, application properties, and payload based on the provided response object.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Creates an error AMQP message with specified status, optional error description, and correlates it with the original request message.
